title: AI Progress and the New Animation Engine
author: Outrageous_Idea_1990
selftext:
I’ve been working on two important areas in Cricket Management Tycoon: improving the match AI and building a new animation engine.

The goal is to make on-field decisions feel more believable while giving matches clearer, more natural movement. The animation engine is still in development, but it will give me a much stronger foundation for improving batting, bowling, fielding, and wicketkeeping animations over time.

There’s still plenty of testing ahead, and I’ll share more clips as the work progresses. Thanks for continuing to follow the development and share your feedback.
